jq.name: the workflow plugin is a job plugin that declares the run_script import and requires script
jq.expr: plugin | .name == "workflow" and .job == true and .host_imports == ["run_script"] and (.script_runtime == null) and (.input_schema.required | index("script") != null) and .instructions == "plugins/workflow/TOOL.md" and .limits.wall_clock_secs <= 900

jq.name: the caller template names only the read-only worker, lists it as a caller target without direct starts, and ships dynamic as check (a pack may not ship run)
jq.expr: (tool("workflow-caller") | .agents.target_ids == ["wf-read-only"] and .agents.enabled != true) and (tool("workflow-caller") | .integrations.plugins[0] | .plugin == "gents/workflow" and .job.policy.dynamic == "check" and .job.policy.dynamic_targets == ["wf-read-only"] and .job.agent_targets == ["wf-read-only"])

jq.name: the worker is read-only with no network and no session history
workflow instructions state the bounded job contract
jq.expr: .assets["plugins/workflow/TOOL.md"] | (length <= 3000) and contains("{effects:") and contains("{job_calls:") and contains("{result:") and contains("{suspend:") and contains("{fail:") and contains("input.job_results.<id>.result.slots[slot].text") and contains("Never request failed or") and contains("not another read request") and contains("plugin_job_stalled") and contains("gents automation job promote") and contains("child_output: {slots") and contains("result: {row_doc_id") and contains("plugin_job_step_failed") and contains("agent_budget")
